summary: Cumberland Pharmaceuticals entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with an affiliate of Apotex Inc. to sell its FDA-approved product portfolio (Acetadote, Caldolor, Kristalose, Sancuso, Vaprisol, Vibativ) and certain equity interests for $100M in cash at closing. The board unanimously approved the transaction and recommends shareholder approval. Cumberland retains its Emerging Technologies unit and ifetroban candidates. Closing requires majority shareholder vote and customary conditions including regulatory clearance. Key watchpoints: shareholder voting timeline, any regulatory hold, and Apotex's ability to close. Risk-arb spread will hinge on deal certainty and timing.
